measures.title: Bartow County Homestead Exemption
measures.summary: A special election on a local Act of the General Assembly. It would amend the existing $15,000 homestead exemption from Bartow County ad valorem taxes for county purposes to increase the exemption to $30,000.
measures.yesMeans: The homestead exemption from Bartow County property taxes for county purposes would increase from $15,000 to $30,000 of assessed value.
measures.noMeans: The county homestead exemption stays at $15,000.
